document.name: SignInSignUp
document.purpose: One screen where a returning customer signs in and a new customer signs up, by email and password or with Google or GitHub.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.doc: Which form is showing: 'sign-in' or 'sign-up'. The screen opens on the one the container asks for.

inputs.name: onModeChange
inputs.doc: Called when the person switches between the sign-in and sign-up forms.

inputs.name: name
inputs.doc: Sign-up name field value.

inputs.name: email
inputs.doc: Email address field value.

inputs.name: password
inputs.doc: Password field value.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.doc: True while a submission or provider sign-in is in flight.

inputs.name: error
inputs.doc: Message for a rejected sign-in or sign-up, empty while there is nothing to say. For a wrong email or password it must not say which was wrong.

inputs.name: onSignIn
inputs.doc: Submit the sign-in form.

inputs.name: onSignUp
inputs.doc: Submit the sign-up form.

inputs.name: onGoogle
inputs.doc: Start sign-in with Google.

inputs.name: onGithub
inputs.doc: Start sign-in with GitHub.

inputs.name: resetPasswordHref
inputs.doc: Where a forgotten password is reset.

props.title: Welcome
props.description: Sign in to your account or create a new one.

document.name: DeploymentAssistant
document.purpose: A conversation with a deployment assistant: the turns above, a composer below, an empty state that says what the assistant can do.

inputs.name: turns
inputs.doc: The conversation, oldest first.

inputs.name: streaming
inputs.doc: True while a reply is arriving.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The composer text.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.doc: Files attached to the draft.

props.title: Deployment assistant
props.description: Ask about your deployment. The assistant can read logs and, with your permission, restart a service.

props.title: Ask about your deployment
props.description: The assistant can read your service logs to find what went wrong, and restart a service once you allow it.

document.name: UsageOverview
document.purpose: Shows a team lead how much of their plan the team has used in a chosen period.

inputs.name: period
inputs.doc: The selected period value: this month or last month.

inputs.name: periodOptions
inputs.doc: The two options for the period switch.

inputs.name: onPeriodChange
inputs.doc: Called when the reader picks a period.

inputs.name: stats
inputs.doc: Requests, error rate, median latency, seats used of seats bought; pre-formatted, each with a delta carrying direction and whether it is good. While loading, placeholder values holding the same four cards.

inputs.name: daily
inputs.doc: Requests per day across the period, one row per day.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.doc: True while the numbers load.

inputs.name: onDownload
inputs.doc: Downloads the period's usage as a file.

props.title: Usage overview
props.description: How much of your plan the team has used this period.

document.name: OrderPage
document.purpose: One customer's order for a support agent: its status and facts, its history, the team's comments with a composer, and a confirmed refund.

inputs.name: order
inputs.doc: The order. Carries name, statusLabel, statusTone ('neutral'|'accent'|'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'), customer, placedAt (already formatted), total, paymentMethod, shippingAddress.

inputs.name: events
inputs.doc: The order's events, newest first. Each title says what happened and who did it; time is already formatted.

inputs.name: comments
inputs.doc: The CommentThread.Comment members for the support team's comments, each with author, avatar, time (how long ago) and body, in reading order.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The text of the comment being written.

inputs.name: postDisabled
inputs.doc: True while the draft is empty or a post is in flight.

inputs.name: refundDescription
inputs.doc: States what is at stake, including the amount, e.g. 'Refund $120.00 to the Visa ending 4242. This cannot be undone.'

inputs.name: refundLabel
inputs.doc: The confirm verb with the amount, e.g. 'Refund $120.00'.

inputs.name: refundDisabled
inputs.doc: True when the order cannot be refunded (already refunded).

inputs.name: onBack
inputs.doc: Returns to the list of orders.

inputs.name: onRefund
inputs.doc: Issues the refund once confirmed.

document.name: BookRoomScreen
document.purpose: Lets an employee book a meeting room by choosing room, date, start time, length, invitees and an optional note, with errors reported beside each field and in a summary.

inputs.name: rooms
inputs.doc: The known rooms, as Select options.

inputs.name: durations
inputs.doc: The lengths on offer: 30, 60 and 90 minutes, as Select options.

inputs.name: room
inputs.doc: Chosen room value; empty string when none.

inputs.name: date
inputs.doc: Chosen date.

inputs.name: startTime
inputs.doc: Chosen start time.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.doc: Chosen length value; empty string when none.

inputs.name: invitees
inputs.doc: Email addresses of the people invited.

inputs.name: note
inputs.doc: Optional note for the invitation.

inputs.name: today
inputs.doc: Today's date, the earliest bookable date.

inputs.name: errors
inputs.doc: Per-field error text after a failed submit; each is undefined when the field is valid.

inputs.name: summaryErrors
inputs.doc: Every problem in form order, each with the id of its field; empty until a submit fails.

inputs.name: summaryTitle
inputs.doc: Title of the error summary.

inputs.name: submitting
inputs.doc: True while the booking is being made.

inputs.name: submitLabel
inputs.doc: Label for the primary action: the booking label, or the in-progress label while submitting.

inputs.name: validateInvitee
inputs.doc: Normalises an email address or rejects it with null.

inputs.name: onSubmit
inputs.doc: Validates and books the room.

inputs.name: onCancel
inputs.doc: Leaves the screen without booking.

props.title: Book a room
props.description: Choose a room and a time, then invite the people who should come.

props.label: Invitees
props.description: Type an email address and press Enter or comma.

document.name: IncidentsScreen
document.purpose: Lets an on-call engineer search, filter, sort and delete the incidents their services raised.

inputs.name: incidents
inputs.doc: The incidents that match the current filters, already ordered by the container.

inputs.name: hasNoIncidents
inputs.doc: True only when there are no incidents at all, before any filter.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.doc: Title, service, severity, status, opened (sortable) and a delete action that calls onRequestDelete.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.doc: Controlled sort; defaults to opened, descending.

inputs.name: status
inputs.doc: Open or resolved; null is both.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the delete confirmation is showing.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: Question naming the incident, e.g. Delete “DB failover”?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Consequence naming the incident, and that it cannot be undone.

props.title: Incidents
props.description: Incidents raised by your services, newest first.

$object.title: No incidents
$object.description: None of your services has raised an incident.

$object.title: No incidents match
$object.description: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every incident.

document.name: OnboardingProfileStep
document.purpose: The first of four setup steps, collecting the new customer's name, role and optional photo, with a way to leave and finish later.

inputs.name: activeIndex
inputs.doc: Zero-based index of the current step; earlier steps are shown finished.

inputs.name: name
inputs.doc: The name entered so far.

inputs.name: nameError
inputs.doc: Error for the name field; empty while there is none.

inputs.name: role
inputs.doc: The selected role value, empty until chosen.

inputs.name: roleOptions
inputs.doc: The short list of roles to choose from.

inputs.name: roleError
inputs.doc: Error for the role field; empty while there is none.

inputs.name: photoFiles
inputs.doc: The photo as an upload row; empty when none chosen.

inputs.name: onBack
inputs.doc: Unused while Back is unavailable on the first step.

inputs.name: continueDisabled
inputs.doc: True until both name and role are filled in.

inputs.name: onSaveAndExit
inputs.doc: Leaves setup, keeping everything entered so far.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.doc: True while the container is saving.

props.title: Set up your account
props.description: Tell us a little about yourself. This is step 1 of 4.

document.name: WorkspaceSettings
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner adjust general, notification and access settings that apply instantly, with a separate danger zone for transferring or deleting the workspace.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.doc: Current workspace name.

inputs.name: onWorkspaceNameChange
inputs.doc: Applies the new name at once.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.doc: Selected IANA time zone.

inputs.name: timeZoneOptions
inputs.doc: Time zones to choose from.

inputs.name: digestEnabled
inputs.doc: Whether members get the email digest.

inputs.name: digestFrequency
inputs.doc: 'daily' or 'weekly'.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyOptions
inputs.doc: Daily and weekly.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyDisabled
inputs.doc: True while the digest is off, so the frequency cannot be set.

inputs.name: membersMayInvite
inputs.doc: Whether members may invite other people.

inputs.name: transferOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the transfer dialog is open.

inputs.name: transferCandidateOptions
inputs.doc: Other members who could become owner.

inputs.name: transferCandidate
inputs.doc: Chosen new owner.

inputs.name: onTransferConfirm
inputs.doc: Transfers ownership to the chosen member.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the delete confirmation is open.

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Names the workspace and says that deleting is irreversible and deletes every project in it.

inputs.name: onDeleteConfirm
inputs.doc: Deletes the workspace.

props.title: Workspace settings
props.description: Changes apply as soon as you make them.

props.label: Workspace name
props.description: Shown to every member and in invitations.

props.label: Time zone
props.description: Sets the time zone in which dates are shown.

props.label: Email digest
props.description: Sends members a summary of workspace activity by email.

props.label: Digest frequency
props.description: Sets how often the digest is sent.

props.label: Members can invite
props.description: Lets any member invite other people to the workspace.

props.label: Transfer ownership
props.description: Makes another member the owner of this workspace.

props.title: Transfer ownership
props.description: Choose the member who will become the owner of this workspace.

props.label: Delete workspace
props.description: Permanently deletes the workspace and every project in it.
